entities.name: Query chitin deacetylase
observations: 298 aa secreted protein with an N-terminal signal peptide-like segment and acidic predicted pI of 4.53.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein A0A1L3THR9 from Pestalotiopsis sp.
Contains Pfam Polysacc_deac_1 domain at residues 36-158 and Chitin_bind_1 domain at residues 259-292.
Homolog evidence supports EC 3.5.1.41 chitin deacetylase activity, converting chitin N-acetylglucosamine units to chitosan and acetate.
Likely extracellular and involved in fungal cell-wall carbohydrate remodeling and possible host immune evasion.

entities.name: A0A1L3THR9
observations: Reviewed Pestalotiopsis sp. chitin deacetylase; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as secreted, extracellular, chitin-binding, and chitin deacetylase-active.
May contribute to evasion of host immune responses by deacetylating chitin-derived elicitors.

entities.name: Chitin deacetylation
observations: Chitin N-acetyl-D-glucosamine polymers are hydrolyzed to chitosan and acetate.
Associated with EC 3.5.1.41 and Rhea RHEA:10464.

entities.name: Fungal chitin remodeling
observations: Chitin deacetylation participates in carbohydrate metabolism and chitin catabolic/cell-wall remodeling processes.
